about: The sites the owner is signed in to in Zeus's own Chrome, for signedin.py. Every entry below is a PLACEHOLDER: nobody has looked at the real pages yet. A placeholder entry is never read and always answers 'unknown'. To fill one in: open the site's account page in Zeus's Chrome while signed in and copy (1) its exact address into account_url, (2) two or three short pieces of text that only a signed-in page shows into signed_in; then open the same address signed out (a private window is fine) and copy (3) the address it lands on, or the part of it that says sign-in, into signed_out_url and (4) one or two pieces of text only the sign-in page shows into signed_out. Then delete the placeholder line. 'hosts' and 'match' are real already.

walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.account_url: PLACEHOLDER: address of the Walmart account page
signed_in: PLACEHOLDER: text only a signed-in Walmart account page shows
signed_out: PLACEHOLDER: text only the Walmart sign-in page shows
signed_out_url: PLACEHOLDER: the part of the address that says it is the Walmart sign-in page
